Class Parking

java.lang.Object
com.realestate.management.model.Parking
public class Parking extends Object
Represents a parking space (Parking) within the building's basement.

This class manages the simple lifecycle of the parking unit (Parking.Status.FREE or Parking.Status.SOLD), its physical dimensions, and size classification logic.

Author:
Juan Carlos Alfaro Jiménez

    • THRESHOLD

      public static final double THRESHOLD
      Defines the threshold in square meters to classify a parking space as "Large".

      Current value: 12.0 square meters.

      private Parking.Status status

      The monetary value of the parking space in euros.

      private double squareMeters

      public boolean matchesSurface(double min, double max)
      Verifies if the parking space's surface area falls within a specific range.
      Parameters:
      min - The minimum surface area.
      max - The maximum surface area.
      Returns:
      true if squareMeters is between min and max (inclusive).

    • matchesPrice

      public boolean matchesPrice(double min, double max)

      Parameters:
      min - The minimum price.
      max - The maximum price.
      Returns:
      true if price is between min and max (inclusive).

    • matchesSize

      public boolean matchesSize(int filter)
      Filters the parking space based on its size classification.
      Parameters:
      filter - The filter code:
      • 0: Any size (always returns true).
      • 1: Small spaces (returns true if NOT large).
      • 2: Large spaces (returns true if large).
      Returns:
      true if the space matches the filter criteria.

    • sell

      public boolean sell(String dni)
      Marks the parking space as Parking.Status.SOLD to a specific buyer. Validates that the DNI is valid before proceeding.
      Parameters:
      dni - The identification of the buyer (cannot be null or empty).
      Returns:
      true if the operation was successful, false if DNI was invalid.

    • release

      public void release()
      Releases the parking space, resetting it to its initial available state.

      Sets status to Parking.Status.FREE and clears buyerDni.
